tools.name: seo_research_keywords
tools.description:
Use this when you need keyword ideas, SEO research, or content planning data for a topic. Returns keyword suggestions and intent data in JSON.

Returns: 1. suggestions array (Google autocomplete) 2. relatedQueries with modifiers (vs, for, how to, best, what is) 3. longTailKeywords array 4. searchInt
